PainterlyNPR__PassViewer__Config__Meta.ConfigNote: Every buffer the pass viewer can show. Id is the view shader's switch; every pass shows its first view as its thumbnail.

WorldNormals.Label: World normals - the way each surface faces in the scene, whatever the camera: +x red, up green, +z (out of the cottage front) blue; their opposites go dark

Distance.Label: Distance to the nearest wash edge (1 mm bands)

Lines.Label: Line candidates - ink primary, terracotta secondary, ochre tertiary, blue optional, green organic; grey hidden, magenta simplified away

Accents.Label: Accent layer - picked bricks and tiles (brick red), flowers (rose, lavender, cream, calendula, chamomile, cornflower)

Indication.Label: Material indication - every joint the pattern lays (grey), the ones drawn (brick red), lost to the paper (magenta)

LineField.Label: Line field - heavier (ink) and lighter (white), break-up (terracotta), hatching (violet), detail kept (blue) or suppressed (magenta)

ShadowLines.Label: Shadow lines - the marker strokes beside each reveal and glazing bar, on the side away from the sun

Clouds.Label: Volumetric clouds - the cloud buffer of 63__Atmos__VolumetricClouds: sunlit white, shaded grey, clear sky blue

CloudMasses.Label: Cloud masses - the cloud buffer simplified into the shapes the wash paints (a Kuwahara on the buffer, never the picture): sunlit white, shaded grey

Kuwahara.Label: Kuwahara filter - the main watercolour settled by 57__Wash__KuwaharaFilter, before the embellishments (flowers, picked units, shadow lines) and the ink go over it
